Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
